title: Never Again! A Protest and a Warning Addressed to the Peoples of Europe
summary: "Never Again! He vividly describes the irony of soldiers forming bonds with their supposed enemies while being commanded to fight against one another, pointing to the broader insanity of armed conflict. Throughout the text, Carpenter emphasizes the need for unity, compassion, and collective action among the masses, rather than blind allegiance to governments that perpetuate violence for their own ambitions. The book serves as both a heart-wrenching testament to the brutality of war and a hopeful call for a peaceful, collaborative future grounded in love and understanding.
